changes.comment: BREAKING: Review: RuntimeActivity and TeammateActivity tool.call now carry three required neutral display facts beside the tool name: summary (the one line the runtime's own UI labels the call with) invocation (the call as a person would write it, such as the shell command line), and items (what the call is about, one entry each, as the runtime's protocol lists them — today the files a read or edit touches; empty otherwise); TeammateActivity adds summary_truncated and invocation_truncated. A provider outside this repository must populate them (null when it has no label) to compile. No rebuild is needed.
